title: Pollen reference slide
description: A modern pollen reference slide with provenance, morphology, a controlled mountant and calibrated images for each picture.

title.title: Title
title.description: Give this record a short name, such as what you saw and where.

observedOn.title: Date
observedOn.description: The day you saw or collected it (YYYY-MM-DD). If you're not sure of the day, give a range such as 2026-10-01/2026-10-03.

locality.title: Place
locality.description: Describe the place in words. Keep it general if the exact spot could put a species, site or person at risk.

observer.title: Observer or collector
observer.description: Who saw or collected it. This can be you.

description.title: What you saw or did
description.description: Describe what you observed. Keep what you saw separate from what you think it means.

method.title: How you recorded it
method.description: How you observed, collected or captured it, and anything you did differently from usual.

rightsLicense.title: Licence
rightsLicense.description: Records use CC BY 4.0 unless the package says otherwise. Use the licence URI.

sourceReference.title: Source
sourceReference.description: Where the evidence comes from: your field notebook, a project, an instrument log or a publication.

uncertaintyNote.title: What's uncertain
uncertaintyNote.description: Say what is uncertain, estimated or missing. Write 'none known' if nothing is.

curatorReviewReference.title: Curator review reference
curatorReviewReference.description: A curator fills this in after a review. Entering it yourself doesn't mean a review happened.

citationText.title: Citation
citationText.description: How you'd like others to cite this version.

qualityStatement.title: Quality statement
qualityStatement.description: The checks you made, what's missing and any limits a reader should know.

archivePackageReference.title: Archive package reference
archivePackageReference.description: A link to a preservation package. Having one here doesn't mean an archive accepted it.

recordBasis.title: What kind of record is this?
recordBasis.description: Human observation if you saw or heard it yourself. Machine observation for a camera trap or sound recorder. Preserved specimen for a pinned or pressed specimen. Living specimen for a garden or captive organism. Occurrence only if you can't tell.

taxonomicRank.title: How far you could identify it
taxonomicRank.description: The most precise level your evidence supports. Genus or family is fine when you can't be sure of the species.

taxonKingdom.title: Kingdom
taxonKingdom.description: Kingdom, such as Animalia, Plantae or Fungi. It helps the name check avoid look-alike names.

taxonSuborder.title: Suborder
taxonSuborder.description: Suborder, if your checklist uses one.

taxonSpecificEpithet.title: Specific epithet
taxonSpecificEpithet.description: The second word of a species name only, not the whole name.

taxonInfraspecificEpithet.title: Infraspecific epithet
taxonInfraspecificEpithet.description: The subspecies, variety or form word, if there is one.

taxonScientificName.title: Scientific name
taxonScientificName.description: The Latin name without cf., aff. or sp. Put those in the qualifier field.

taxonAuthorship.title: Name authorship
taxonAuthorship.description: The author of the name, if you know it.

taxonNameAccordingTo.title: Name according to
taxonNameAccordingTo.description: The publication or checklist the name comes from.

taxonNomenclaturalCode.title: Naming code
taxonNomenclaturalCode.description: The code of naming the source follows, if you know it.

taxonIdentificationQualifier.title: Identification qualifier
taxonIdentificationQualifier.description: Use cf. (compare with) or aff. (similar to) when you're not certain.

taxonomicStatus.title: Name status
taxonomicStatus.description: Whether the checklist treats the name as accepted, a synonym and so on.

taxonBackbone.title: Checklist used for the name
taxonBackbone.description: The checklist you checked the name against, such as the Catalogue of Life via GBIF, the Australian Plant Census or the Australian Faunal Directory.

taxonBackboneVersion.title: Checklist version
taxonBackboneVersion.description: The checklist version or the date you checked it.

taxonConceptId.title: Taxon identifier
taxonConceptId.description: The checklist's identifier for the name. Copy it from the checklist; never make one up.

identificationBasis.title: Why you think it's that
identificationBasis.description: What helped you identify it: features, a field guide or key, a call, or a specialist. For an unusual find, say how you ruled out look-alikes.

identificationUncertainty.title: How sure you are
identificationUncertainty.description: How strongly your evidence supports the name.

slideIdentifier.title: Slide identifier
slideIdentifier.description: Identifier for the prepared slide or reference mount.

pollenTaxonName.title: Pollen taxon
pollenTaxonName.description: Taxon associated with the reference pollen; a determination may remain above species level.

pollenOrigin.title: Pollen origin
pollenOrigin.description: Origin of the pollen material and how it was obtained.

preparationMethod.title: Preparation method
preparationMethod.description: Chemical and physical preparation method, with safety context kept in the lab record.

mountant.title: Mountant
mountant.description: What the slide is mounted in, in your words.

stain.title: Stain
stain.description: Stain or optical treatment, if any.

polarView.title: Polar view
polarView.description: View in which the grain was measured.

grainShape.title: Grain shape
grainShape.description: Observed grain shape using a stated vocabulary or reference.

apertureType.title: Aperture type
apertureType.description: Aperture type, such as colpus, pore, or colporus.

grainCount.title: Grains measured
grainCount.description: Number of grains measured for the summary.

microscopeMagnification.title: Microscope magnification
microscopeMagnification.description: Effective magnification used for the observation.

pollenDispersalUnit.title: Pollen dispersal unit
pollenDispersalUnit.description: Monad, dyad, tetrad, polyad, massula, or pollinium when the unit is observed; use the free-text field for an unmapped term.

pollenTetradConfiguration.title: Tetrad configuration
pollenTetradConfiguration.description: Configuration of a tetrad when applicable.

pollenPolarity.title: Pollen polarity
pollenPolarity.description: Polarity of the grain using the candidate Clio vocabulary.

pollenSymmetry.title: Pollen symmetry
pollenSymmetry.description: Symmetry of the grain using the candidate Clio vocabulary.

pollenShapeClass.title: Pollen shape class
pollenShapeClass.description: P/E-ratio shape class, or ‘other’ when the supplied observation does not map to these classes. Retain the raw axes and any verbatim term.

pollenAperturePresence.title: Aperture presence
pollenAperturePresence.description: Whether an aperture was observed. Inaperturate is distinct from an unrecorded observation.

pollenApertureTypes.title: Controlled aperture types
pollenApertureTypes.description: One or more controlled aperture terms; retain apertureType for a verbatim or unmapped description.

pollenAperturePosition.title: Aperture position
pollenAperturePosition.description: Position of the aperture(s), when observed.

pollenApertureFeatures.title: Aperture features
pollenApertureFeatures.description: Observed aperture features, such as an annulus, margo, costa, operculum, or aperture membrane.

pollenOrnamentation.title: Controlled ornamentation
pollenOrnamentation.description: One or more controlled surface-ornamentation terms; retain sculpture for a verbatim description and method context.

pollenObservationMethod.title: Pollen observation method
pollenObservationMethod.description: Microscopy or observation method associated with the controlled pollen traits.

pollenMaterialState.title: Material state
pollenMaterialState.description: Hydration or preparation state relevant to apparent size and shape.

pollenMorphologyRemarks.title: Morphology remarks
pollenMorphologyRemarks.description: Retain useful specialist wording, limitations, and terms that are not yet represented by the candidate vocabulary.

pollenReferenceCollectionName.title: Reference collection name
pollenReferenceCollectionName.description: Name of the source pollen reference collection, when the slide belongs to one.

pollenReferenceCollectionCurator.title: Reference collection curator
pollenReferenceCollectionCurator.description: Person or organisation responsible for curating the source reference collection.

pollenReferenceCollectionAccessUri.title: Reference collection access URI
pollenReferenceCollectionAccessUri.description: Stable HTTPS page or endpoint through which the source reference collection can be accessed.

pollenIdentificationType.title: Identification type
pollenIdentificationType.description: How the reference identity is supported. Preserve details and uncertainty in the identification fields.

originalTaxonVerbatim.title: Original taxon wording
originalTaxonVerbatim.description: Taxon wording exactly as it appeared in the source collection before any current-name mapping.

originalTaxonFamily.title: Original family
originalTaxonFamily.description: Family recorded by the source collection, retained separately from the current determination.

originalTaxonGenus.title: Original genus
originalTaxonGenus.description: Genus recorded by the source collection, retained separately from the current determination.

originalTaxonSpecificEpithet.title: Original specific epithet
originalTaxonSpecificEpithet.description: Specific epithet recorded by the source collection.

originalTaxonAuthorship.title: Original name authorship
originalTaxonAuthorship.description: Scientific-name authorship recorded by the source collection.

voucherInstitutionCode.title: Voucher institution code
voucherInstitutionCode.description: Herbarium or other voucher institution code, when the pollen is linked to a preserved voucher.

voucherIdentifier.title: Voucher identifier
voucherIdentifier.description: Catalogue or accession identifier for the linked voucher.

livingCollectionInstitutionCode.title: Living collection code
livingCollectionInstitutionCode.description: Botanic-garden or living-collection institution code, when applicable.

livingPlantIdentifier.title: Living plant identifier
livingPlantIdentifier.description: Accession or plant identifier in the living collection.

fieldIdentificationReference.title: Field identification reference
fieldIdentificationReference.description: Field number, collector reference, notebook entry, or other direct-identification evidence.

pollenCollectedBy.title: Pollen collected by
pollenCollectedBy.description: Person or organisation credited with collecting the source material.

pollenCollectionYear.title: Pollen collection year
pollenCollectionYear.description: Year the source material was collected, when only a year is known.

pollenPreparedBy.title: Slide prepared by
pollenPreparedBy.description: Person or organisation credited with preparing the slide.

pollenPreparationYear.title: Slide preparation year
pollenPreparationYear.description: Year the slide was prepared, when known.

pollenPreparationTreatment.title: Most destructive treatment
pollenPreparationTreatment.description: Most destructive preparation treatment known to have been applied; describe variants in preparation method.

pollenDigitisedBy.title: Digitised by
pollenDigitisedBy.description: Person or organisation credited with producing the digital representations.

pollenDigitisationYear.title: Digitisation year
pollenDigitisationYear.description: Year the slide was digitised, when known.

pollenCuratedBy.title: Reference curated by
pollenCuratedBy.description: Person or organisation responsible for the reference-collection curation statement; this does not itself record a Clio review decision.

pollenMicroscopeConfiguration.title: Microscope configuration
pollenMicroscopeConfiguration.description: Microscope, camera, objective, ocular and acquisition configuration relevant to interpreting the images.

pollenImageCalibrations.title: Per-image calibration and focus stack
pollenImageCalibrations.description: One entry per image, keyed by mediaOrdinal or mediaObjectId, with micrometresPerPixel or the two calibration distances. Two-point method: click both ends of a known length on a micrometer or scale bar and record the pixels and micrometres.

pollenSingleGrain.title: Single-grain record
pollenSingleGrain.description: Whether the record and linked imagery describe one specifically tracked pollen grain.

pollenSampleAgeType.title: Sample age type
pollenSampleAgeType.description: Kind of age statement supplied for the material; preserve the original statement in sample age wording.

pollenSampleAgeVerbatim.title: Sample age wording
pollenSampleAgeVerbatim.description: Age, date, uncertainty, calibration and reference exactly as supplied; do not infer a numeric age from this field.

externalPollenCollectionIdentifier.title: External pollen collection identifier
externalPollenCollectionIdentifier.description: Identifier assigned by GPP or another reference-collection system; name the system in the assertion source.

externalPollenSlideIdentifier.title: External pollen slide identifier
externalPollenSlideIdentifier.description: Slide identifier assigned by GPP or another exchange partner; name the system in the assertion source.

verbatimIdentification.title: What you think it is
verbatimIdentification.description: Type what you saw in your own words, common or scientific. We keep it exactly as you typed it.

taxonNameResolution.title: Name check result
taxonNameResolution.description: Check the scientific name against a checklist and record the result. 'No match, kept as typed' is a fine answer.

pollenMountantType.title: Mountant type
pollenMountantType.description: Glycerol, glycerol jelly, silicone oil or other. This matches the Global Pollen Project's choices.

assertion.description: A value with provenance. Use it when a field's source, method, unit, uncertainty or visibility matters.
